Albert Einstein’s theory of relativity changed how we understand the universe by linking space, time, and gravity. It consists of two parts: special relativity, which deals with high-speed particles and the cosmos, and general relativity, which explains gravity. In simple terms, Einstein showed that massive objects like stars and planets bend the fabric of space and time around them. This bending is what we experience as gravity.

The first three months of the year are January, February, and March.
